$comment: The recorded size of skills/*/SKILL.md, used as a ratchet by scripts/check-skill-corpus.mjs (pass 3 of validate-artifacts.sh): the corpus may shrink freely and may only grow through a commit that re-records this file with `node scripts/check-skill-corpus.mjs --update-baseline`. No threshold is chosen here, so no threshold can be set too high — `words` is what the corpus was, not what it is allowed to be. Words rather than bytes or lines because prettier reflows Markdown at 100 columns, which moves both of those on a pure reformat and moves no words; the unit also continues the 11 116 that de-ratchet-the-solo-lane recorded. `words` is the sum of `perSkill`, and both count whitespace-separated runs over the whole file including frontmatter — reproduce it with `cat skills/*/SKILL.md | wc -w`. Why the ratchet exists at all: docs/decisions/0009.
